description.p: Gerenciador de Chaves Segura is a lightweight Bitcoin wallet focused on speed, with low resource usage and simplifying Bitcoin. Startup times are instant because it operates in conjunction with high-performance servers that handle the most complicated parts of the Bitcoin system.
